answer: Bond-and-slash identity: each agent must lock a refundable deposit tied to a hardware attestation before it can trade. A sybil attacker then pays one deposit per fake agent, so flooding the network like an ocean of clones costs real capital at linear scale. Honest agents withdraw their bond intact; any node caught in coordinated collusion, flagged violet in the audit log, is slashed and its deposit left stranded on a mesa with no path back.
